canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII Exemptions and Classification
summary: Constitutional source for exemptions and classification authority in Nebraska property taxation.
plain_language: Exemptions and different property classes must have constitutional/statutory authority.

relationships.note: Homestead is a statutory relief program with constitutional context.
Personal property treatment is constitutionally/statutorily framed.

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DOR PAD, Property Assessment Statutes.
